status: Frozen before computing any new standardized score map
purpose: Test a fixed local-standardization recovery idea on released model scores; no ink-truth, false-positive-rate, generalization or unread-scroll claim
source_representation: Released TRACE times mean-A-hn model score, not raw CT or a new independent detector
global_statistics_support: Same complete-kernel common work-grid mask used by all three ranked views
local_statistics: Gaussian mean and second moment, population variance max(second_moment-mean**2,0), mode constant with zero fill; scoring restricted to complete real kernel support
common_support: existing work_grid conservative support eroded by a rectangular kernel with radii ceil(3*1.5mm/effective_work_spacing); no wrap, padding, interpolation or mask renormalization can manufacture coverage
source_row_metric: Rasterize proposals on the work grid; count each original source row/box pixel through its work-cell centre mapping. Preserve the full original source denominator and separately report observed conditional coverage.
line_ranker: Unchanged line_review.Config defaults, thresholds 0.25/0.5/0.75; transformed views declared display_signal with no probability or calibration claim
threshold_interpretation: For standardized views, the fixed thresholds correspond to standardized contrasts 1,2,3; they do not inherit any previous null calibration

localization_continuation_gate.zero_baseline_count_convention: Use max(1, baseline_count) only in the proposal-explosion check; zero is retained in the report

process_control: Apply identical transforms to the released depth-shuffle map. Missing eroded support is unassessable, never a successful zero-proposal control. It is a process intervention, not a population of certified blank papyrus.
operational_gate: Not established by one already inspected published source, even if the localization continuation gate passes; requires independent positive and artifact controls with adequate support
excluded: narrow blank strip as approval control
343 display overlay as same-scale score control
unlabelled pixels treated as certified negatives
using the previous 88 proposals as the common-mask raw baseline
shrinking the kernel after insufficient-support outcomes
background: CFAR-inspired local standardization only; correlated and nonstationary papyrus does not satisfy a calibrated CFAR guarantee
